cohort: The study included 74 oral iron-intolerant, second- and third-trimester iron-deficient gravidas.
finding: Intravenous iron significantly improved maternal hemoglobin and iron parameters with minimal toxicity, and the majority of infants (57/58) showed normal growth and development and no iron deficiency anemia up to 11 months.
followup_time: Maternal parameters were measured 4 weeks postinfusion or postpartum, and infant growth data were available up to 11 months.
